description: One row for each thing that can be open in work with aidd, so nothing opens and never closes. A row gives four facts: who opens it, what closes it, who may close it, and what finds one left open, with the step that closes it. A work item's statuses stay in the schema its row of schemas/item-types.json points to, so a row here names only the status groups that close it. `aidd doctor` reads the rows of the machine class for the commands its notes give. A record or a commit is written once and is never open, so neither has a row.

classes.durable: a work item or a typed document with a status in its file
classes.dated: a thing with an end date, or one a person or a role releases
classes.machine: a thing a run opens on the machine or the platform

closers.opener: the run that opened it, or the run its handoff note names as the new owner
closers.lead: the lead, for the roles it started and what they left open
closers.person: only a person, because closing it is a person's decision

finders.aidd status: lists it among the open work
finders.aidd validate: warns or fails while it is open past its date
finders.aidd doctor: notes it as left open, with the command that closes it
finders.aidd delegate check: defers every delegated ask while it is open past its date
finders.the lead's close-out: the lead lists it at the end of a change, and closes or names each one

spec.opened_by: a role or a person, with `aidd new spec`
spec.closes_when: its status reaches a group in `closes_in_groups`
spec.close_with: the status transition `references/state.md` gives, after a person's merge approval or decline

intent.opened_by: the product manager, with `aidd new intent`
intent.closes_when: its status reaches a group in `closes_in_groups`
intent.close_with: the status transition `references/state.md` gives, once its phases are done or a person cancels it

proposal.opened_by: the delivery manager, with `aidd new proposal`
proposal.closes_when: its status reaches a group in `closes_in_groups`
proposal.close_with: a person's go/no-go, sign-off, or outcome, recorded in its front matter

postmortem.opened_by: the SRE after an incident, with `aidd new postmortem`
postmortem.closes_when: a person publishes it and each action item is done
postmortem.close_with: record `done: true` on each action, or its owner sets a new `due`

exploration.closes_when: a person picks a direction and the role records the pick
exploration.close_with: the role records the person's pick in `outcome`

delegation.opened_by: a person, in a reviewed change to `.aidd/config.yaml` (`aidd init --delegate`)
delegation.closes_when: `review_due` passes, or a person removes the block
delegation.close_with: a person sets a new `review_due` in `.aidd/config.yaml`, or removes `delegation`

waiver.opened_by: a person, who grants it in `project.waivers`
waiver.closes_when: its `until` passes, or the work meets the rule
waiver.close_with: a person removes the waiver from `.aidd/config.yaml`, or grants a new one

rule_review.opened_by: the rule's owner, who sets `review_due` on a project rule
rule_review.closes_when: the owner reviews the rule and sets a new date, or drops the rule
rule_review.close_with: the owner sets a new `review_due` in `.aidd/config.yaml`, or removes the rule

support_period.opened_by: a person, who declares the product's support period
support_period.close_with: a person sets a new `ends_on`, or ends the product's support

emergency_backfill.opened_by: the author of a production repair, with `aidd new spec --route emergency`
emergency_backfill.closes_when: the backfill Spec and the post-incident review are done

feature_flag.opened_by: the architect, in a Spec's `flags`, an experiment's flag too
feature_flag.closes_when: a merged Spec lists it in `removes_flags`
feature_flag.close_with: a cleanup Spec that deletes the flag and lists it in `removes_flags`

deprecation.closes_when: a merged Spec lists it in `removes_deprecations`
deprecation.close_with: a Spec that removes it and lists it in `removes_deprecations`

snoozed_suggestion.opened_by: a person, who snoozes suggested work in its `triage`
snoozed_suggestion.closes_when: its `until` passes and a person decides again
snoozed_suggestion.close_with: a person records a new `triage` decision

wait.opened_by: the role or the person who names what a work item waits on
wait.closes_when: what it waits on is done, and the role clears `waiting_on`
wait.close_with: clear `waiting_on`, or finish the item `blocked_by` names

raid_entry.opened_by: the delivery manager or the product manager, in a RAID log entry with a `due`
raid_entry.close_with: the entry's owner records its new status, or sets a new `due`

waiting_stop.opened_by: the lead, when a role or a runner outlasts its session (lead rule 3)
waiting_stop.closes_when: the run goes on and a later note replaces it
waiting_stop.close_with: resume the run from the note, and write a new note

open_decision.opened_by: a role, on its handoff note
open_decision.closes_when: the lead answers it on its own note's `decided`, or puts it on `needs`
open_decision.close_with: the lead's answer on `decided`, before it merges the role's work

unanswered_ask.opened_by: a role or the lead that reaches an `ask`
unanswered_ask.closes_when: the person answers, or the work moves on and the question is stale
unanswered_ask.close_with: the person's answer, recorded with `aidd records add`

role.opened_by: the lead, when it starts a role
role.closes_when: its handoff note is in, and the lead merged or declined its work
role.close_with: the harness's own stop for the role

worktree.opened_by: the lead, when it starts a role in its own checkout
worktree.closes_when: its commits are on the change's branch and its role is done

branch.opened_by: the lead or the harness, with a role's worktree

background_process.opened_by: the run that starts a server, a browser, a watcher, or a preview
background_process.closes_when: its purpose ends, before the run hands off, or once a person has looked at a preview
background_process.close_with: stop the process the run started, by the harness's stop or its process id

port.opened_by: the process that listens on it
port.closes_when: the process that holds it stops
port.close_with: stop the process that holds the port

scratch_folder.opened_by: a run, with `mktemp -d` under `.aidd/tmp/` or the harness's scratchpad
scratch_folder.closes_when: no run needs it, which the lead or a person judges
scratch_folder.close_with: a person deletes the folder, once no run needs it; a role never deletes one

open_pr.closes_when: a person merges or closes it
open_pr.close_with: a person's merge on the platform, or its close

index_cache.opened_by: aidd, in the git folder, when a command reads the work items
index_cache.closes_when: never needs to: aidd rebuilds it from the files, so removing it loses nothing
index_cache.close_with: remove the file `aidd doctor` names, and aidd rebuilds it

item_groups.linked: a document a Spec links is frozen with the Spec or lives with it, so the Spec's row covers it
item_groups.standalone: a living document is kept current and never closes
item_groups.repository: the repository has one of each, kept current, and it never closes
item_groups.contract: a contract is signed once, and its proposal's row covers the decision
item_groups.product_scope: a file of the product scope is kept current by a person's approval and never closes; the items in it end by their latest result

item_types.runbook: a living procedure: `aidd doctor` checks the age of its `tested_on`, and nothing waits for it to close
item_types.release: a release file records an event already shipped, and nothing waits for it to close

keys.why: the day a thing happened, written once
a day a person sets for a review or a target, which the step code `product_scope.review_due` is named for once it has passed; no code reads one yet, so a later change gives each a row
a day a person chooses for work to start or for a criterion to be measured: `measure_on` changes the day `aidd status` gives, and no code reads `start_on` yet, so a later change gives it a row
a standing setting with no end, which a person changes in a reviewed change to the config
